items.set_title: The Last Days of Checkpoint Kilo

parts.title: Day 1: The Sealing
parts.description: A corporal's voice, steady but strained: 'Checkpoint Kilo sealed at 0600. Twelve personnel. Air filtration nominal. Rations for 30 days. We'll wait it out.'

parts.title: Day 12: The First Death
parts.description: The corporal's voice is quieter now: 'Private Chen didn't wake up this morning. We don't know why. The dosimeters read safe. But she just... stopped.'

parts.title: Day 30: The Ration Split
parts.description: Voices arguing in the background. The corporal: 'We're down to half rations. Three more have the cough. I'm not sure the filter is working as well as the gauge says.'

parts.title: Day 47: The Final Entry
parts.description: Static. Then, barely audible: 'This is Corporal Maren. If you find this — the filter failed. It was lying to us the whole time. Don't trust the gauges. Trust your lungs. Maren out.'

parts.title: Triage Protocol
parts.description: A doctor's voice, clinical: 'St. Maren's Hospital, Day Zero plus six hours. We're implementing triage protocol Omega. Patients are categorized by survival probability. I hate this.'

parts.title: The Hardest Decision
parts.description: The doctor is crying: 'We had to choose. There were too many. We chose the young ones — the ones who might see a future. The others... the others we made comfortable. God forgive us.'

parts.title: The Pharmacy Key
parts.description: A final entry: 'The pharmacy is locked. The key is in my office, behind the diploma. Take everything. Use it for someone who can still be saved. That's what I would have wanted.'

parts.title: The First Week
parts.description: A father's voice, with children's laughter in the background: 'We're in the basement bunker. Maria is keeping the kids busy with board games. The radio says the worst has passed. We'll give it another week.'

parts.title: The Cough
parts.description: The father, hoarse now: 'Maria has the cough. The little one — Ana — she's running a fever. We're running out of the iodine pills. If anyone finds this... the backyard shed has extra water.'

parts.title: The Last Game
parts.description: Silence, then a child's voice, terribly small: 'Papa can't talk anymore. Mama is sleeping. I finished the board game by myself. I won. I don't know what to do now.'

parts.title: The First Broadcast
parts.description: A young woman's voice, crackling with static: 'This is Free Radio. If you can hear this, you're not alone. We're broadcasting from somewhere the ash hasn't reached yet. Stay inside. Stay alive.'

parts.title: The Warning
parts.description: The same voice, urgent: 'The patrols have started. They're going door to door, conscripting survivors. If they knock, don't answer. Don't let them see your light. Trust no uniform.'

parts.title: The Coordinates
parts.description: Reading coordinates slowly: 'There is a cache at the old library. Medicine, batteries, seeds. It's for anyone who needs it. Take only what you need. Leave the rest for the next survivor.'

parts.title: The Last Transmission
parts.description: The voice, barely a whisper: 'They found us. If you're hearing this, we're already gone. But the cache is still there. And there are others like us — other broadcasts, other survivors. Keep listening. Keep hoping. Free Radio, signing off forever.'
